method: Preserve selected-model row133 logits on unknown TRAIN cells using their frozen-feature covariance. This is a teacher regularizer, NOT negative ground truth.
excluded_supervision: Existing20billboard-positive and35explicit-absence photos are supervised; reviewed traffic-sign query regions are excluded from unknown preservation and supervised separately.
data_loss: Same37geometry-covered positive-query BCE +3*mean existing explicit-negative BCE +3*mean reviewed-region negative BCE.
teacher_penalty: 0.5*lambda*(theta-theta0).T*C*(theta-theta0); C is equal-photo mean of query-feature outer products with appended bias1, unknown TRAIN queries only.
selection: Fit allfour before development evaluation. Same both-baseline strict gain/FP/retention/unscored530 rules and stable tie break.
limits: Conservative teacher preservation may suppress unlabelled true billboards too. It does not establish absence or independent accuracy. Development references are reused and no production/generalization claim is permitted.
